ARUN MOSS TO MAY REED. January 07, 1848
Dear colleague,
Arun Moss asked May Reed to
send the museum catalogue.

ARUN MOSS TO MAY REED. January 07, 1848
Dear colleague,
The depot reported receiving a
copy of the museum catalogue,
but the sender was not
recorded.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
